label: PF Backlog 117
title: Dynamic agent creation - user-defined + AI-recommended MAIN agents
body:
Ability to create/add a MAIN agent with capabilities, model, prompts, inputs, artifacts, dependencies - AI-recommended and/or user-defined, validated, registered, and stitched into the pipeline. (Currently only core/agent_memory.create_agent_memory exists; no dynamic agent synthesis.)
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).

dashboard_impact.reason: Creating/adding a dynamic main agent needs an Agent Builder UI.
